title: Broadcom Slides After AI Chip Forecast Underwhelms Investors
summary: Broadcom Inc. shares declined after a two-year forecast for AI chip sales failed to impress investors, a sign it’s still in the early stages of challenging Nvidia Corp.’s dominance.

title: 137 Ventures’ Returns Soar on SpaceX, Anduril and Cognition Bets
summary: The 2014 fund of early SpaceX backer 137 Ventures is now worth more than eight times the money investors originally put into it, net of fees and other charges.

title: Nvidia Acquires AI Platform Hugging Face for $13 Billion
summary: Nvidia Corp. has agreed to acquire artificial intelligence startup Hugging Face in a transaction valued at about $13 billion.

title: Elliott Builds Deutsche Telekom Stake, Opposes T-Mobile Merger
summary: Elliott Investment Management has built a sizeable stake in Deutsche Telekom and indicated the German telecommunications giant should ditch a potential merger with its American arm T-Mobile US, people familiar with the matter said. Swetha Gopinath reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chipmaker Longsys Is Said to Price Hong Kong Listing at HK$236
summary: Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co. priced its Hong Kong listing below the top end of the marketed range, according to people familiar with the matter, joining a wave of Chinese companies along the artificial intelligence supply chain to debut in the city.

title: ElevenLabs Hires OpenAI VP as First Chief Revenue Officer
summary: ElevenLabs has hired former OpenAI executive Ashley Kramer as its first chief revenue officer, part of the  startup’s efforts to drum up business demand for  its artificial intelligence voice tools.

title: HPE Slides After Sales Boost Misses Highest Expectations
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. shares fell by the most in 17 months after the company reported increasing sales that didn’t meet high expectations from investors, who have seen the stock price more than double so far this year.

title: Snowflake Jumps on Revenue Outlook, Uptake of AI Assistant
summary: Snowflake Inc. shares jumped by the most in three months after the company raised its outlook for annual sales, topping analysts’ estimates, and touted rapid adoption of its AI-assisted coding tool.

title: Thoma Bravo’s Proofpoint Is Said in Talks to Acquire Cybersecurity Firm Varonis
summary: Thoma Bravo-backed Proofpoint Inc. is in talks to acquire cybersecurity company Varonis Systems Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in what would be one of the biggest technology take-privates since the steep selloff in software stocks earlier this year.

title: Nvidia Buying AI Platform Hugging Face in $13 Billion Deal
summary: Nvidia has agreed to purchase artificial intelligence startup Hugging Face. The transaction is valued at about $13 billion and includes an up to $1 billion equity-based retention program for Hugging Face employees that join Nvidia. Carmen Reinicke reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Saudi Arabia’s Humain Unveils AI Model Based on China’s MiniMax
summary: Saudi Arabia’s artificial intelligence company Humain has built a national AI platform based on an open model from Chinese lab MiniMax Group Inc., joining a growing list of countries seeking tighter control of the increasingly important technology.

title: HTC Brings $499 Vive Eagle Smart Glasses to US Amid Broader Privacy Concerns
summary: HTC Corp. is rolling out its Vive Eagle smart glasses in the US, entering a market where category leader Meta Platforms Inc. is already facing mounting concerns from consumers over clandestine camera recording.

title: US Stock Futures Today: Broadcom, HPE, Snowflake, Ultragenyx
summary: S&P 500 Index futures are little changed as of 7:53 a.m. in New York. Technology shares are in focus, following results from with chipmaker Broadcom and Hewlett Packard Enterprise.

summary: The companies are under scrutiny for failing to join rivals on protections for young people

title: Bezos’ Blue Origin Has Poached Dozens of Amazon Satellite Engineers
summary: Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin is developing its planned satellite network with the help of employees poached from another Bezos project:   Amazon.com Inc.

title: Wiz Founder Backs Israeli Startup Guardio at $1.1 Billion Value
summary: Israeli cybersecurity startup Guardio raised funds from investors including Assaf Rappaport, the founder of cloud security firm Wiz, in a round that values the company at $1.1 billion.

title: Adam Smith’s Lessons for Investors in the Age of AI
summary:
In this episode of Merryn Talks Money, host Merryn Somerset Webb is joined by Bloomberg Senior Reporter John Stepek, Schroders Head of Strategic Research Duncan Lamont and Nelsons Chairman and Creative Scotland Chair Robert Wilson for a special roundtable recorded at Panmure House during the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. Marking 250 years since the publication of The Wealth of Nations, they ask what Adam Smith can teach the world about artificial intelligence, government intervention and investing.

The panel discusses whether policymakers interfere too much in markets, why holding too much cash can be a risk in itself and whether investors should worry about buying stocks at record highs. They also explore what the rise of AI could mean for jobs, trust and the relationships that hold societies together.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: K-Pop Billionaire Bang Referred to Prosecutors, Yonhap Says
summary: South Korean police shared with prosecutors the findings of a long-running investigation into BTS agency Hybe Co. founder Bang Si-hyuk over allegations he misled investors ahead of the company’s 2020 listing.
